cases.name: 1. stable UTC period identities: snapshot:<day> and weekly:<week>:<today>
cases.details: Verified exact stable keys snapshot:YYYY-MM-DD and weekly:YYYY-MM-DD:YYYY-MM-DD; daily snapshot and weekly payout execute once; repeated tick replays without new effects.

cases.name: 2. two concurrent workers produce exactly one business effect per stable key
cases.details: Two concurrent schedulers ticking for the same period result in exactly one outcome in economy.command_outcomes, one payout, and one wallet credit.

cases.name: 3. downtime catch-up processes elapsed UTC days in order and settles the closed week
cases.details: Simulated downtime across multiple days and closed week: catchUp iterates missed days in strict chronological order and settles the closed week without double-crediting.

cases.name: 4. unplaced and weekly-ineligible accounts receive zero fabricated rewards
cases.details: Unplaced and weekly-ineligible players receive zero weekly payouts, zero ledger entries, and zero coin modifications.

cases.name: 5. close() is idempotent and never closes the borrowed Core
cases.details: Scheduler close is idempotent and releases scheduler state without closing the borrowed Core service.

verification.summary: Season, leaderboard, and maintenance scheduling extracted into packages/services/maintenance-scheduler.js. Uses stable UTC period identities (snapshot:YYYY-MM-DD and weekly:YYYY-MM-DD:YYYY-MM-DD) and Core-owned operator commands; proves two concurrent workers produce exactly one business effect; verifies downtime catch-up and zero fabricated rewards across 5 dedicated tests on real PG16.
